subjects.description: one person cooking in a home kitchen, filmed from a head-mounted camera
subjects.visibility: hands and manipulated objects visible; face not visible (egocentric view)

prompt: A person in a home kitchen moves the bowl exactly 2 times, moves the fork exactly 2 times, and moves the pen exactly 1 time. Each pick-up-and-set-down of an object counts as one move. No other move of these objects happens in the clip.

events.definition: The person moves the bowl: picks it up and sets it down somewhere else. Each pick-up-and-set-down counts as one move. This action is judged visually; no specific sound is required.
The person moves the fork: picks it up and sets it down somewhere else. Each pick-up-and-set-down counts as one move. This action is judged visually; no specific sound is required.
The person moves the pen: picks it up and sets it down somewhere else. Each pick-up-and-set-down counts as one move. This action is judged visually; no specific sound is required.
